I am a former fruit fly cytogeneticist turned bioinformatics data scientist. I currently work at the National Bioinformatics Infrastructure Sweden ([NBIS](https://nbis.se/staff/employee-15)) at [Uppsala University](https://www.uu.se/en/contact-and-organisation/staff?query=N23-421). 

At NBIS I support research projects as a bioinformatician, and also teach in workshops for PhD students, researchers, and group leaders. I am also involved in the European Reference Genome Atlas ([ERGA](https://www.erga-biodiversity.eu/), [BGE](https://biodiversitygenomics.eu/)) by doing a bunch of genome assemblies.

I am interested in computational biology and data science. Big fan of only moderately painful learning, as well as fully automated luxury communism.
